thesis: This run focused on maintaining a strategic approach by leveraging the Quality Matrix's top picks, emphasizing strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. We successfully opened a long position on **Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX)**, driven by its strong composite score and robust copper grade of 2.2% Cu, anchored by NGEx Lunahuasi. The other top picks, **GR Silver Mining Ltd. (GRSL.V)** and **A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V)**, were not reopened due to the churn guard cooldown following recent auto-rebalance closures.
